about: Luke carefully tells the story of Jesus, who came to find and save the lost.

pages.title: Jesus Is Born
pages.scene: Baby Jesus in the manger with Mary, Joseph and shepherds
pages.text: Mary and Joseph went to Bethlehem. There was no room at the inn, so baby Jesus was born and laid in a manger. Angels told shepherds, "Good news! A Savior is born!" The shepherds hurried to see the baby.
pages.lesson: Jesus is God's gift to the world.

pages.title: The Good Samaritan
pages.scene: The Samaritan helping the hurt man
pages.text: Jesus told a story. A man was hurt by robbers on the road. A priest walked past. Another man walked past. Then a Samaritan stopped. He bandaged the man and paid an innkeeper to care for him. Jesus said, "Go and do the same."

pages.title: The Lost Sheep
pages.scene: A shepherd carrying a lamb on his shoulders
pages.text: A shepherd had one hundred sheep. One got lost. He left the others and looked everywhere until he found it. He carried it home on his shoulders and said, "Celebrate with me!" Jesus said heaven is happy like that when one person comes back to God.

pages.title: The Son Who Came Home
pages.scene: A father running to hug his son
pages.text: A son took his money and left home. He wasted it all and ended up feeding pigs. He said, "I'll go home and say sorry." His father saw him coming, ran to him and hugged him. "My son is home!" he said, and threw a big party.
pages.lesson: God is always ready to welcome us home.

pages.title: Zacchaeus
pages.scene: Zacchaeus up in a tree looking at Jesus
pages.text: Zacchaeus was a short man who cheated people. He climbed a tree to see Jesus. Jesus stopped and said, "Zacchaeus, come down! I'm coming to your house today." Zacchaeus was so happy. He gave back what he took and more!

pages.title: Jesus Is Risen!
pages.scene: The empty tomb with the stone rolled away
pages.text: Jesus died on the cross and was buried. On Sunday morning, women came to the tomb. The stone was rolled away! Angels said, "He is not here. He is risen!" Later Jesus came to His friends and ate with them. He is alive!
